Name: Playground Football
Design brief: One chunky classic association-football soccer ball, bright ivory panels and navy pentagonal panels with thick clean seams, a few broad glossy highlights. Slightly softened inflated toy sphere, no writing or grass.

Name: Playground Basketball
Design brief: One bright orange basketball with broad clean dark navy curved seams, slightly softened toy sphere and simple glossy highlights, minimal surface texture and no writing.

Name: Foam Bonker
Design brief: One small extra-chunky foam TOY baseball bat, short lavender handle with rounded knob and oversized soft-looking hot-pink rounded barrel with one cyan band. Clearly a short harmless foam play bat, diagonal pose, no lettering.

Name: Tumble Barrel
Design brief: A compact throwable wooden barrel, squat round body with six broad honey-brown staves, two thick navy metal hoops, chunky rivets, flat circular wood lid with a simple handgrip recess. No hazard labels or spilled contents.

Name: Zoom Juice
Design brief: A squat rounded flask with opaque turquoise-blue liquid, cream bevelled frame edges, navy stopper and a large raised yellow lightning-bolt emblem on its front. Tiny solid blue handle loop on one side. Potion shape is readable without any written label.

Name: Spring Sip
Design brief: A pear-shaped squat potion bottle with opaque lime-green liquid, navy thick base and stopper, a large white upward-chevron emblem and a wide yellow spring coil encircling the bottle neck. Single clear silhouette, no floating effects.

Name: Ember Elixir
Design brief: A chunky round potion flask with opaque orange-red liquid, cream shoulder rim, dark navy stopper and one simple raised yellow flame emblem on its front. A small red heat-coil band hugs the neck. Friendly fantasy consumable, not realistic incendiary equipment.

Name: Surprise Present
Design brief: One chunky square turquoise gift box with thick magenta ribbon crossing all sides, oversized simple cream bow made of two broad loops on top. Solid toy-like bevelled corners and navy seam edging. No tag or writing.

Name: Plunger Popper
Design brief: A squat chunky cartoon TOY plunger launcher: teal chamfered box body, large orange flared trumpet muzzle with one red rubber suction cup visibly seated at its mouth, cream inset side panel, navy edging, short orange grip and a small rounded pressure tank. Similar toy construction to the provided heat/mud blasters. No realistic weapon mechanics or text.

Name: Frost Ray
Design brief: One playful cyan and ivory FREEZE-RAY toy blaster with chamfered box body, large flared pale-blue muzzle, dark navy edge trim, a compact opaque ice-crystal tank on top, short teal rubber grip and one simple snowflake badge on the side. Broad simple shapes like the user's toy mud/heat guns, no realistic weapon details, beam or particles.

Name: Paint Splash
Design brief: One squat paint bucket with thick navy rim, a sturdy cream handle attached on both sides, glossy cyan paint filling the top and two thick attached cyan drips over a magenta bucket body. One plain cyan splat emblem, no text, no detached splashes.

Name: Eggsploit
Design brief: One oversized intact creamy-white cartoon chicken egg with a warm golden lower cel-shaded edge, a small blue protective sticker shaped like a simple oval patch and a glossy highlight. Rounded pear-like egg shape, no face, no writing, no cracks or loose shell pieces.

Name: Cake Toss
Design brief: One small round two-layer chocolate cake with broad ivory frosting, a single fat strawberry firmly attached on top and three sculpted chocolate drips at the edge. No candles, plate, cutlery or scattered crumbs. Stable chunky throwable toy-food silhouette.

Name: Camp Torch
Design brief: One chunky friendly fantasy hand torch: short dark-brown wooden handle, thick cream wrap bands, navy bowl-shaped collar and a compact sculpted orange-yellow flame sitting directly in that collar. The flame is a solid simple three-lobed cartoon form, no sparks, smoke or detached effects.

Name: Bounce Pad
Design brief: A compact low circular spring-loaded bounce pad, yellow raised centre disc, thick cyan octagonal base, navy bumper rim, three broad attached orange compression springs visible under the disc. Three-quarter view from slightly above.
